rules.title: C# syntax error
rules.description: The C# parser reports a syntax error; the file does not compile as written.

rules.title: Empty catch block
rules.description: A catch block with no statements and no comment silently swallows exceptions.

rules.title: Rethrow loses the stack trace
rules.description: 'throw ex;' inside a catch block resets the exception's stack trace; 'throw;' preserves it.

rules.title: Async void method
rules.description: An async void method that is not an event handler cannot be awaited and its exceptions crash the process.

rules.title: Possible hard-coded secret
rules.description: A password, token, API key or similar secret is assigned a string literal in source code.

rules.title: Vulnerable NuGet package
rules.description: A direct or transitive NuGet package has a known vulnerability according to the configured package sources (dotnet list package --vulnerable).

rules.title: Possible null reference
rules.description: A value that can be null in a reachable path is dereferenced, or a nullable annotation is contradicted by the code.

rules.title: Logic error
rules.description: A condition, calculation or control flow does not do what the surrounding code clearly intends.

rules.title: Boundary or unexpected value
rules.description: Off-by-one errors, invalid indexes, empty collections, overflow or unexpected input values are not handled.

rules.title: Incorrect exception handling
rules.description: Exceptions are caught too broadly, lost, misreported or leave state inconsistent.

rules.title: Concurrency issue
rules.description: Shared state is accessed without proper synchronization, or a race condition or deadlock is evident in the code shown.

rules.title: Resource leak or incorrect disposal
rules.description: An IDisposable or IAsyncDisposable object (stream, connection, HttpClient handler...) is not disposed, disposed too early, or HttpClient is created per request.

rules.title: Unawaited task
rules.description: A Task is started and not awaited or observed, so failures are lost and ordering is not guaranteed.

rules.title: Blocking on asynchronous code
rules.description: Task.Result, Task.Wait() or GetAwaiter().GetResult() blocks on asynchronous work, risking deadlocks and thread-pool starvation.

rules.title: Cancellation token not propagated
rules.description: An available CancellationToken is not passed to asynchronous calls that accept one.

rules.title: N+1 queries or repeated external calls
rules.description: A database query, HTTP call or other external call is issued once per item of a loop or collection.

rules.title: Unbounded data retrieval
rules.description: A query loads far more data than used, or has no pagination where the result set can grow without limit.

rules.title: Inefficient LINQ or repeated enumeration
rules.description: An IEnumerable is enumerated several times, or a LINQ chain does needless work (for example Count() > 0 instead of Any()).

rules.title: String concatenation in a loop
rules.description: Strings are built by repeated concatenation in a loop where a StringBuilder would avoid quadratic copying.

rules.title: Unnecessary allocations or expensive operations
rules.description: Work in a hot path allocates or recomputes needlessly, for example creating Regex or serializer instances per call.

rules.title: SQL injection
rules.description: Untrusted input is concatenated or interpolated into SQL instead of being passed as parameters.

rules.title: Command or other injection
rules.description: Untrusted input reaches a process command line, LDAP, XPath, template, log or other interpreter without neutralization.

rules.title: Path traversal
rules.description: A file path built from untrusted input can escape the intended directory.

rules.title: Unsafe handling of external input
rules.description: External input (request data, files, messages) is used without validation, size limits or encoding where it matters.

rules.title: Authorization or access-control flaw
rules.description: An operation on protected data or functionality is reachable without the authorization checks the code base applies elsewhere.

rules.title: Insecure cryptography
rules.description: Weak algorithms (MD5, SHA-1, DES), fixed keys or IVs, insecure random numbers for secrets, or disabled certificate validation.

rules.title: Insecure deserialization
rules.description: Untrusted data is deserialized with type-resolving serializers (BinaryFormatter, TypeNameHandling, ...) that allow arbitrary types.

rules.title: Unnecessary complexity
rules.description: Excessively long methods, deep nesting or convoluted logic that a simpler structure would express clearly (KISS).

rules.title: Duplicated logic
rules.description: Substantial logic is duplicated where a shared implementation would prevent the copies from diverging (DRY).

rules.title: Dead code or unused variables
rules.description: Code that can never run, or variables, parameters and members that are never used.

rules.title: Misleading naming
rules.description: A name contradicts what the code does, in a way that is likely to cause misuse.

rules.title: Incorrect dependency direction
rules.description: Code depends on a layer or component it should not, contrary to the structure visible in the project or its documented architecture.

rules.title: Too many responsibilities
rules.description: A class or method mixes unrelated concerns, with concrete evidence of SOLID violations that hinder change.

rules.title: Excessive coupling
rules.description: Components depend on each other's internals, making them hard to change or test independently.

rules.title: Unnecessary abstraction
rules.description: An interface or layer adds indirection without a current need such as testing, multiple implementations or isolation.

rules.title: Changed behavior without tests
rules.description: Important behavior or an error path introduced by the change has no corresponding test in the code shown, considering the project's conventions.

rules.title: Fragile or nondeterministic test
rules.description: A test depends on time, ordering, shared state, the network or sleeps in a way that can make it fail intermittently.

rules.title: Missing timeout or resilience
rules.description: A call to an external dependency has no timeout, cancellation or retry policy where a failure would hang or cascade.

rules.title: Inadequate logging or error handling
rules.description: Failures are not logged with enough structured context to diagnose them, or sensitive data is logged.

rules.title: Unsafe environment-specific configuration
rules.description: Development-only settings, hard-coded endpoints or inconsistent configuration can reach production.

rules.title: Missing health or readiness checks
rules.description: A hosted service or web application that is deployed and monitored exposes no health or readiness check, when that fits the application type.

profiles.name: default
profiles.description: Every rule that is enabled by default.

profiles.name: security
profiles.description: Security rules only, including exposed secrets.
